items.title: Is Essential Properties Realty Trust (EPRT) Undervalued Following Its Expanded Credit Facility?
items.summary: Why Essential Properties Realty Trust tapped more credit now Essential Properties Realty Trust (EPRT) amended its main credit agreement in mid-September 2026, lifting its revolving credit facility from $1.0b to $1.3b and revising several key lending terms. The real estate investment trust adjusted pricing on its revolver and term loans, released subsidiary guarantees tied to the facility, reset a $700.0m accordion feature, and fully repaid its separate Capital One credit agreement.
